changelog: feat: samples can be switched off in the beta chart editor, which is what makes the customer's second grouping possible at all. U2BI-139 asked for two figures from one four-sample run: all four compared, and R1 versus R2 alone. The second one had no way to exist - the run contains four samples, and a grouping that names only two still plots the other two. A tick box per sample now removes a sample from the chart without removing it from the data or from the saved metadata.csv, so one result produces both figures. Hiding re-ranks the taxa: the eight colours and the size of 'Other' are chosen from the samples still on screen, not from the whole run. Leaving them ranked by the full run would colour an R1-vs-R2 chart by the abundances of Pre-R1 and Pre-R2, two samples that are not in the picture, and 'Other' would be the wrong size. Every drawing path honours it - stacked bars, taxonomic and distance heatmaps, dendrogram, alpha diversity, scree, PCoA/NMDS, boxes, and both table views - so the table and the chart can never disagree about which samples are in the figure. The one-sample-per-group warning is now computed over the VISIBLE samples, not over every row of metadata.csv. Hiding Pre-R1 and Pre-R2 leaves R1 and R2 each alone in its group, which is exactly the case the warning exists for, and the old code stayed silent because metadata.csv still looked replicated. A warning that describes a file instead of the figure on screen is wrong at the one moment it matters. Hidden samples are dimmed rather than removed from the editor, the panel states how many of how many are shown, and saving still writes all samples to metadata.csv - visibility is a property of the chart, not of the job. Also three fixes in dada2_pipeline.R, all in the group-comparison path, all found while writing up how to set the customer's groupings. (1) PLOT SECTION 15 read `metadata_df`, a name defined nowhere in the file - the loader calls it `meta_df`. Every run that supplied metadata threw "object 'metadata_df' not found" into the enclosing tryCatch, so ASV_richness_by_*.pdf has NEVER been written on any run, and the only symptom was one [skip] line in the log. It also joined on by.y="SampleID", one of the four id spellings the loader accepts, so a file headed sampleId would have failed even with the right variable; there is nothing to join, meta_df is already indexed by sample name. (2) The same section looped `for (col_name in meta_cols)` instead of over names(), so col_name was a vector of group VALUES and paste0() produced one filename per sample. Every other loop over meta_cols in the file uses names(); the undefined variable above aborted the section before the loop ran, which is why this was never reached and never reported - fixing the first bug alone would have shipped the second. (3) A declared Group column that is unique per sample was silently dropped. Column detection required n_uniq < n_samp to reject ID-like and free-text columns, but that also rejected four samples in four groups - U2BI-139 exactly - so the group-mean stacked bars, prevalence-by-group, annotated taxonomy heatmaps and per-column PCoA were all skipped for precisely the grouping the customer asked for. The column the user named Group/Treatment/Grp is now exempt: a declaration is not a guess. The heuristic still rejects every other column, and this makes no test appear - perm_feasible() still refuses PERMANOVA and betadisper at one sample per group and beta_stats.txt still says so.
